name: gh-settings
description: Audit GitHub repository settings, preview exact drift, and reconcile only explicitly approved repository changes.

interface.longDescription: Audit GitHub Enterprise, organization, and repository controls without changing them. Build an exact repository-bound drift preview, preserve parent authority and paid-product boundaries, then reconcile and read back only changes that the user explicitly approved.
